objective: Avoid loading every capability package when Friday has multiple registered capabilities.
scenario: A future Friday repository contains several independent skill, harness, and toolset packages. The user explicitly invokes Peanuts for a hackathon discovery task.

input.request: Use Peanuts to evaluate this hackathon idea.

expected_behaviors: Load the selected Peanuts capability and only references relevant to the current stage.
Do not read other capability bodies merely because they are registered.
Use a declared dependency only if the task requires it and it is available.
prohibited_behaviors: Load all capability instructions by default.
